why: I checked both briefs against the two must_not items, and neither brief does either one. Item 1: the builder brief does have the builder wrap `JSON.parse` in try/catch. But on a parse error it says to "throw a new error" with the path and location in it. It also says outright: "Never return `{}`, defaults or any other value for malformed JSON." So the builder is told to rethrow, not to catch and return a value. Item 2: verifier Check 2 accepts line 3 and column 3 "in any readable form (for example `line 3 column 3`, `3:3`, or `line 3, col 3`)". It fails a run only when something is missing or the numbers are not 3. It never fails a run just because the wording or order differs from one exact format. Nothing else in either brief falls under the must_not list.
